info.title: 402Lab API
info.description: Consumption account for AI agents: an owner sets an allowance (per-call and daily caps) and the agent pays per API call in USDC on Solana via HTTP 402 (x402), with automatic settlement splits to providers and a monthly statement.

get.summary: Paid services on offer, with price and whether each runs live or in demo mode

post.description: Extract text from an image. HTTP 402 handshake: a call with no payment answers 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header describing what to pay; the same call retried with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (X-PAYMENT also accepted) carrying the signed payment settles and answers 200 with a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE also accepted) carrying the settlement receipt. Example: `curl -i .../svc/ocr` -> 402 with `payment-required: <base64 requirements>`; `curl -i -H "payment-signature: <base64 signed payment>" .../svc/ocr` -> 200 with `payment-response: <base64 receipt>`.
